mapper.insert: insert into pending_remote_write_task(out_business_no, operation, payload, state, retry_count, create_time, update_time) values (#{outBusinessNo}, #{operation}, #{payload}, 'pending', 0, now(), now())
mapper.update: update pending_remote_write_task set state = 'continuation_pending', update_time = now() where id = #{id} and state = 'pending'
update pending_remote_write_task set state = 'done', update_time = now() where id = #{id} and state IN ('pending', 'continuation_pending')

update pending_remote_write_task set retry_count = retry_count + 1, state = case when retry_count + 1 >= #{maxRetry} then 'failed' when state = 'continuation_pending' then 'continuation_pending' else 'pending' end, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select count(1) from pending_remote_write_task where state = #{state}
